Formula Z = [1, X, Wy]; H = [1, X, WX] (instrumentOrder 2 adds W^2 X); P = H (H'H)^-1 H'. delta = (Z'PZ)^-1 Z'P y; u = y - Z delta; sigma2 = u'u/n; se_j = sqrt(sigma2 [(Z'PZ)^-1]_jj); z_j = delta_j/se_j with a standard-normal p-value. The constant is centred out; the intercept is ybar - mean(Z) delta. Anselin-Kelejian AK = (u'Wu/sigma2)^2 / (T + 4a/sigma2), with T = tr(W'W + WW) and a the estimation-variance term, tests the residuals for spatial autocorrelation; it equals n I_u^2/phi2 and does not depend on the total weight S0. Moran's I_u = (n/S0) u'Wu/u'u is undefined when S0 = 0. The displayed default scenario uses classical standard errors. Optional robust.method selects HC0, HC1, HC2, HC3, clustered CR1 or spatial HAC covariance, replacing table standard errors, z statistics and normal p-values while retaining classical summary diagnostics; robust covariance includes PSD certification status.
